hits.title: Profound Raises $35M Series B as AI Search Becomes the Next Platform Shift
hits.snippet: NEW YORK, Aug. 12, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Profound, the platform that helps businesses control how they appear in AI responses, today announces a $35 million Series B round led by Sequoia with continued participation from Kleiner Perkins, Khosla Ventures, Saga VC, and South Park Commons. This brings Profound's total funding to $58.5 million.

hits.title: Ex-Swiggy, Zomato execs raises $1.5 mn for AI career startup | Bengaluru News - The Times of India
hits.snippet: Bengaluru: Former Swiggy executive Anuj Rathi and former Zomato chief technology officer Prashant Parashar have raised $1.5 million in seed funding for Profound, an AI startup building digital representatives for professionals.The round saw participation from Swiggy co-founders Sriharsha Majety and Nandan Reddy, former Zomato co-founder Pankaj Chaddah, Razorpay co-founder Harshil Mathur, Cred founder Kunal Shah and OfBusiness co-founder Bhuvan Gupta. Stellaris Venture Partners and 3one4 Capital also invested.Profound creates an “AI Rep” through a voice conversation lasting about 30 minutes. The system seeks to understand a person’s career, expertise, goals, preferences and working style. It can then help prepare professional profiles and introductions, and match users with jobs and other connections.“The way I think about Profound is that we want to create a global AI platform that gives every professional their own AI Rep,” Rathi told TOI. “Athletes have agents and actors have managers. Professionals should have an AI representative that understands them deeply.”The startup has conducted over 1,000 AI calls during its pilot phase and helped close a few roles, Rathi said.

hits.title: Ex-Swiggy, Zomato leaders raise $1.5 million for AI startup | News Karnataka
hits.snippet: Bengaluru: Former Swiggy executive Anuj Rathi and former Zomato Chief Technology Officer Prashant Parashar have raised $1.5 million (around ₹13 crore) in seed funding for their artificial intelligence startup, Profound, which aims to build AI-powered digital representatives for professionals.

The new funding takes the total raised by Profound to $155 million.
